statement: For complex A q-by-m and B m-by-q, det(AB)=sum over q-subsets I of m det(A[:,I])*det(B[I,:]); includes q=0 and q>m.

proof.text: Expand determinant multilinearly in rows or columns; duplicate intermediate indices vanish by alternatingness.
Group injective intermediate-index functions by image subset, keeping permutation signs and empty case.
